# Test fixtures

`controller/` contains only notification UUIDs and packet bytes from measured
iPega input. Device identifiers, MAC addresses and phone/session information are
omitted. These packets exercise trigger deduplication and auxiliary-button edges.

`vision/pose.jpg` and `vision/portrait.jpg` come from Google's public MediaPipe
test assets at `https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/`. The other two
images are reproducible engineering fixtures generated by
`tests/generate_vision_fixtures.py`: a crop and a face composite. They test two
distinct reference identities and hit geometry. They are not product assets or
evidence of real-world recognition accuracy. Physical selfie photos are excluded.
